annotation.title_en: General product safety ***II (European Parliament legislative resolution on the Council common position) and International standards for ship safety ***II
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities C 34 E
annotation.summary_en: Official Journal extract of European Parliament second-reading legislative resolutions of 16 May 2001 amending Council common positions on a general product safety directive and on port State control of ship safety. Amendments cover precautionary principle, external certification, comitology procedures and a Commission proposal on services safety. No AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Parliament amends the common position on the general product safety directive.
Adds precautionary principle to the Member State measures under Article 8.
Allows producers to prove conformity through external certification.
Requires the Commission to propose safety of services rules before 1 January 2003.
Amends port State control directive 95/21/EC, adding voyage data recorder provisions.
